The matching forbidden composition call (aeo.MountSensorRoutes) makes any future mount fail closed.

The composition package imports internal/affiliates only for the AffiliateSignupNotice type its signup mailer adapter renders (apps/api/event_billing_notification_adapters.go). This file's Deps.MountAdminRoutes and Deps.MountPublicRoutes are not composed, and the reachability scan fails if any composition file refers to either: regenerate.go resolves the reference by type, so a renamed variable, an aliased import, or a method value is caught, whereas the forbidden composition calls affiliatesDeps.MountPublicRoutes and affiliatesDeps.MountAdminRoutes match only that spelling. Both methods also return before registering anything while OperationallyAvailable() is compile-time false, which it stays until the commercial, legal, tax, and payout release gates are approved.

This file's legacy MountRoutes scaffold is dormant and superseded by sessions.go's explicit MountAgentRoutes release boundary. Excluding the source prevents its relative nested registrations from being mistaken for executable routes; the matching forbidden composition call makes any future mount fail closed.
The archived asynchronous remix job/worker scaffold is not mounted; the separate deterministic internal/content_remix campaign draft endpoint remains supported.

The composition package imports internal/inboxreality only to build the Inbox Reality runtime (apps/api/inbox_reality_lifecycle_composition.go). main.go registers all seven Inbox Reality routes itself, as literals, each behind its own API-key scope, the very-expensive tenant limit, or the internal bearer guard. Deps.MountRoutes and Deps.MountInternal in this file apply none of that middleware, and the reachability scan fails if any composition file refers to either: regenerate.go resolves the reference by type, so a renamed variable, a struct field, a method value, or a wrapper elsewhere in the package is caught. MountInternal serves handler tests only. This file therefore declares no reachable route; its handlers reach the inventory through main.go's registrations.
Only this package's background worker is composed. Its heuristic CLV HTTP route scaffold remains unmounted and must not be confused with the mounted internal/predictive surface.
